name: Tsuukin Chikan Densha Akiba Iki ~Joshikousei ni Haiyoru Musuu no Te~
original_name: 通勤痴漢電車 アキバ行き ～女子校生に這い寄る無数の手～
source:
The Commuting Molestation Train:  
They say that there's a certain Akihabara-bound train that attracts men's desires.  It's an urban legend, a phantom train rumored to actually exist.

Three high school girls board the train in order to find out for themselves if those rumors are true.

 - Sakakibara Nene, a 1st-year student - A cute, trendy girl with a modern style.
 - Kasai Kasumi, a 2nd-year student - Despite her quiet personality, she loves anything that feels good. 
 - Natori Saeka, a 3rd-year student - A strict, straight-laced girl who serves on the school's disciplinary committee.

In this train densely crowded with men, the girls' innocent bodies are thoroughly exploited.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008227.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=none]DLSite[/url]]
